answers.name: Cummingtonite
answers.blurb: An amphibole named after Cummington, Massachusetts. Every geology student has sniggered at the name, so it's nowhere near as rare an answer as it feels.

answers.name: Jadarite
answers.blurb: Found in Serbia's Jadar valley in 2004. Its formula is almost exactly the one on the kryptonite case in Superman Returns, minus the fluorine, and it's white, not green.
